name: Mainsail HT90
description:
This is the existing Mainsail app adapted for the Prusa HT90. The header was adjusted to match the Prusa design in both style and color scheme.
The App shows progress in %, ETA in 0h 00min. Nozzle, Bed and Chamber temperature.

[MainsailHT90.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32312917/MainsailHT90.zip)
